features.name: Vaultor Next foundation
features.description: Experimental Windows Tauri notes with indexed managed search, protected drafts, collection organization, protected linked NTFS Markdown and a full-workspace desktop shell with OLED, companion navigation and shared panes.
tasks: Create edit and recover a note after an unexpected close
Review competing saved and protected versions
Browse thousands of notes and organize collection memberships
Select a resource page with Ctrl Shift Space and Ctrl+A
Organize multiple notes using context menus and searchable destinations
Search saved note titles and content and filter by collection or ordering
Register external folders and explicitly save source-preserving Markdown
Review external conflicts and interrupted Save evidence
Return from notes to Library with Back and Forward
Choose OLED black and use the sidebar companion views
limitations: Experimental M2/M3 workspaces; M1 and Electron data are not migrated.
Draft protection follows a debounced SQLite receipt; unsent edits are not crash durable.
No linked files, attachments, deletion or imports/exports.
